skill.name: kleros-ipfs-upload
skill.description: Upload Kleros-related evidence, meta-evidence, policies, and justifications to IPFS through the Kleros x402 gateway. The skill uses Base mainnet USDC payment and returns IPFS CIDs or Kleros gateway URLs.
skill.summary: Upload Kleros ecosystem files to IPFS through a paid x402 gateway on Base mainnet.
skill.author: internet-court

security_audit.summary: This skill has a legitimate Kleros IPFS upload purpose, but it is high risk. It sends local files to an external gateway and signs real Base mainnet USDC payments. Most Markdown backtick findings are false positives, but credential handling, .env loading, configurable endpoints, paid execution, and fresh dependency installation remain confirmed concerns.

remediation.issue: Paid uploads can execute automatically if an agent follows the workflow without a user checkpoint.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user approval for the file path, operation tag, network, payee, and expected USDC cost before each paid upload.

remediation.issue: The raw-key runner uses EVM_PRIVATE_KEY and the CDP runner loads CDP API and wallet secrets.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer minimally funded wallets, scoped CDP accounts, short-lived credentials, and secret stores that do not expose values in prompts or logs.

remediation.issue: The runners upload any path supplied on the command line.
remediation.suggestion: Validate that each path was explicitly selected by the user and refuse hidden files, environment files, credential files, and unrelated system paths.

remediation.issue: The documented setup installs fresh Node dependencies without a committed lockfile.
remediation.suggestion: Pin dependency versions, publish a lockfile, or provide an audited bundled runner before handling wallet or CDP credentials.

remediation.issue: The feedback link points outside the skill directory with a parent-directory path.
remediation.suggestion: Keep feedback material inside the skill package or use an external issue URL instead of a ../ relative path.

semantic_findings.title: Remote Upload of Arbitrary Local Files
semantic_findings.description: Both runners accept a local path, read the file bytes, and post them to the Kleros gateway. If an agent selects the wrong path, local data can be disclosed and pinned externally.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The scripts read process.argv file paths and send the file contents through fetchWithPay. This directly combines local file access with external network upload.

semantic_findings.title: Paid Mainnet Transaction Side Effect
semantic_findings.description: The skill intentionally spends real USDC on Base mainnet for successful uploads and paid smoke tests. Automatic execution could spend funds without clear user approval.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documentation and script comments explicitly state that each successful upload costs USDC on Base mainnet. This is a clear financial side effect.

semantic_findings.title: Fresh Dependency Installation Before Credential Use
semantic_findings.description: The documentation instructs agents to run npm install and then execute the bundled runner, while noting there is no committed lockfile. Fresh dependency resolution increases supply-chain risk before handling payment credentials.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The skill explicitly says to install dependencies at use time and states that dependency versions stay fresh without a lockfile. This is legitimate but risky when wallet or CDP secrets are present.

content.value_statement: Kleros artifacts need durable IPFS references before contracts and subgraphs can use them. This skill pays the Kleros x402 gateway and returns CIDs and gateway URLs.
actual_capabilities: Uploads one or more local files to the Kleros IPFS gateway.
Pays the x402 upload charge with a Base mainnet wallet or CDP account.
Supports evidence, meta-evidence, justification, and custom operation tags.
Returns IPFS CIDs and canonical Kleros HTTP gateway URLs.
Runs free gateway health and discovery checks before paid uploads.
Warns when gateway responses report inconsistent CIDs.
limitations: Every successful upload spends real USDC on Base mainnet.
The gateway limits total request size to 4 MiB.
The skill is intended for Kleros ecosystem artifacts, not generic IPFS storage.
The bundled runners require local Node dependencies and wallet credentials.

use_cases.title: Attach Dispute Evidence
use_cases.description: Upload screenshots, contracts, or supporting documents and receive a URL suitable for a Kleros dispute submission.

use_cases.title: Publish Meta-Evidence
use_cases.description: Pin policy or case metadata files before referencing their CIDs from contracts, events, or deployment scripts.

use_cases.title: Validate Gateway Readiness
use_cases.description: Check the gateway health, x402 discovery metadata, payment network, and expected price before relying on a paid upload.

prompt_templates.title: Upload Evidence File
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner upload for one Kleros dispute artifact
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to upload my selected file as Kleros dispute evidence. Confirm the cost, check the gateway, then return the CID and URL.

prompt_templates.title: Pin Meta-Evidence
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate upload with a specific operation tag
prompt_templates.prompt: Pin my meta-evidence file for a Kleros case. Use the meta-evidence operation and explain which CID I should store on-chain.

prompt_templates.title: Run Free Gateway Checks
prompt_templates.prompt: Run only the free Kleros IPFS gateway checks. Report the x402 price, network, payee, and whether a paid upload should proceed.

prompt_templates.title: Use CDP Server Credentials
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced hosted-agent upload with CDP signing
prompt_templates.prompt: Use a Coinbase CDP server account to upload these Kleros artifacts in one paid request. Confirm credentials, expected spend, and CID consistency.

output_examples.input: Upload a screenshot as evidence for a Kleros dispute.
output_examples.output: The file is pinned. The response includes the IPFS CID and the canonical Kleros gateway URL for the evidence.

output_examples.input: Check the gateway before making a paid upload.
output_examples.output: The health check passed, discovery returned Base mainnet payment terms, and the unpaid upload challenge showed x402 enforcement.

output_examples.input: Pin a meta-evidence document for a contract reference.
output_examples.output: The document is uploaded with the meta-evidence operation. Use the returned CID in the contract or deployment workflow.

best_practices: Confirm the file path, operation tag, price, and network before any paid upload.
Use a minimally funded wallet or scoped CDP account for upload payments.
Run the free health and discovery checks before spending USDC.
anti_patterns: Do not use this gateway for generic IPFS storage without a Kleros need.
Do not place long-lived private keys in shared agent environments.
Do not retry paid uploads repeatedly when one successful CID is enough.

faq.question: What does this skill upload?
faq.answer: It uploads Kleros ecosystem files such as evidence, meta-evidence, policies, metadata, and juror justifications.

faq.question: Does it cost money?
faq.answer: Yes. Each successful paid upload spends USDC on Base mainnet through the x402 payment flow.

faq.question: Which wallet types are supported?
faq.answer: The bundled runners support a raw EVM private key or a Coinbase CDP server account.

faq.question: Can it upload large files?
faq.answer: No. The documented gateway limit is 4 MiB for the total multipart request body.

faq.question: Can I use it for non-Kleros IPFS storage?
faq.answer: The skill recommends other pinning providers for generic IPFS storage that has no Kleros purpose.

faq.question: What output should I expect?
faq.answer: A successful upload returns IPFS CIDs and Kleros gateway URLs that can be shared or referenced by other systems.
